import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int v, w, c, nx;
        Edge(int v, int w, int c, int nx) {
            this.v = v;
            this.w = w;
            this.c = c;
            this.nx = nx;
        }
    }

    static final int oo = 2139063143;
    static int N = 5010000;
    static int P = 1000000007;
    static double eps = 1e-7;

    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    static int readInput() throws IOException {
        while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            if (line == null) return -1;
            st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        }
        return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
    }

    static void writeOutput(int x) {
        System.out.print(x);
    }

    static void printLineOutput(int x) {
        System.out.println(x);
    }

    static int[] dist, flow, pre, las;
    static boolean[] in_q;
    static ArrayList<Edge> edge_array;
    static int[] head_list;
    static int edge_idx;
    static int start, sink_node;

    static boolean spfa_algorithm(int sink_node, int start) {
        int n = sink_node;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            dist[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            flow[i] = 0;
            pre[i] = 0;
            las[i] = 0;
            in_q[i] = false;
        }
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[start] = 0;
        flow[start] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        q.offer(start);
        in_q[start] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            in_q[u] = false;
            for (int kb = head_list[u]; kb != 0; kb = edge_array.get(kb - 1).nx) {
                Edge e = edge_array.get(kb - 1);
                int v = e.v, w = e.w, c = e.c;
                if (w > 0 && dist[v] > dist[u] + c) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + c;
                    flow[v] = Math.min(flow[u], w);
                    pre[v] = u;
                    las[v] = kb;
                    if (!in_q[v]) {
                        q.offer(v);
                        in_q[v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pre[sink_node] != 0;
    }

    static int total_flow_value = 0, total_cost_value = 0;

    static void run_flow(int sink_node, int start) {
        while (spfa_algorithm(sink_node, start)) {
            int u = sink_node;
            int f = flow[sink_node];
            total_flow_value += f;
            total_cost_value += f * dist[sink_node];
            while (u != start) {
                int las_idx = las[u];
                Edge e = edge_array.get(las_idx - 1);
                e.w -= f;
                Edge rev = edge_array.get(las_idx ^ 1);
                rev.w += f;
                u = pre[u];
            }
        }
    }

    static void connect_edges(int u, int v, int w, int c) {
        edge_array.add(new Edge(v, w, c, head_list[u]));
        head_list[u] = edge_idx + 1;
        edge_idx++;
        edge_array.add(new Edge(u, 0, -c, head_list[v]));
        head_list[v] = edge_idx + 1;
        edge_idx++;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        dist = new int[N];
        flow = new int[N];
        pre = new int[N];
        las = new int[N];
        in_q = new boolean[N];
        edge_array = new ArrayList<>();
        head_list = new int[N];
        Arrays.fill(head_list, 0);
        edge_idx = 0;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int B = Math.max(n, k);
        start = n * (B * 2 + 1) + 1;
        sink_node = start + 1;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            connect_edges(start, x, 1, 0);
        }

        connect_edges(n * (B * 2) + 1, sink_node, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);

        for (int o = 0; o < B * 2; o++) {
            connect_edges(o * n + 1, (o + 1) * n + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                connect_edges(o * n + i, (o + 1) * n + i, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c);
            }
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int o = 0; o < B * 2; o++) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                    int cost = d * (2 * i - 1) + c;
                    connect_edges(o * n + x, (o + 1) * n + y, 1, cost);
                    connect_edges(o * n + y, (o + 1) * n + x, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        run_flow(sink_node, start);
        printLineOutput(total_cost_value);
    }
}
